//: The hand-written part of manifest.json. tools/make_manifest.py adds each file's sha256 and size and copies the DLLs (and images) next to it. 'build' and 'image' are relative to the mod's 'repo' (default oth-cars), a checkout next to this one. Versions are plain numbers: Core's in-game installer ignores anything after a '-'.

mods.name: Salochi Core
mods.description: The mod framework every Salochi mod runs on: the in-game MODS page, the mod network, and the car framework. Built on OverTheHillPlus by legomaster188.

mods.name: Winch Fix
mods.description: Multiplayer: a guest's winch no longer re-attaches right after unhooking (a bug in the game). The host and the guests all need it.

mods.name: Shift Fix
mods.description: Multiplayer: a guest's High/Low range switch no longer snaps straight back (a bug in the game). The host and the guests all need it.

mods.name: Accessory Editor
mods.description: Press F8 in the garage to stack accessories, then move, turn and resize each one. You can also set wheel size and offset. Works on every framework car. In multiplayer, other players with the editor see your changes, and you see theirs.

mods.name: Baja Bug
mods.description: A lifted beetle on big tyres and long travel, built on the Brick's wheels and axles: the flat four out in a tube basket and rally lamps up front.
mods.credits: Model: "VW Beetle" by 3DDomino (Sketchfab, CC BY 4.0), made into a Baja and converted.

mods.name: Tacoma TRD Pro (3rd gen)
mods.description: A 2016-2023 double-cab Tacoma TRD Pro on the Burro: 3.5 V6, 18-inch wheels on 32-inch mud-terrains, and 33 / 35-inch tyre upgrades in the garage.
mods.credits: Model: "Toyota Tacoma TRD" by LagzDesign (Sketchfab, CC BY 4.0), refined and converted.

mods.name: 4Runner (4th gen)
mods.description: A lifted 2006-2009 4Runner Limited on the Burro: 4.7 V8, full-time four-wheel drive, 33-inch mud-terrains, running boards and a roof rack.
mods.credits: Model: "Toyota 4Runner" by sadiqminhas (Sketchfab, CC BY 4.0), prepared and converted.
